about_the_game:
Join 2-8 players online or locally across 2 game modes in the Find your friends demo.  Master the art of deduction as you identify real players hidden among swarms of unpredictable AI bots, all while hiding your own movements to avoid detection. Customize your experience with numerous gameplay modifiers that transform each mode into a fresh and thrilling challenge.

Features

  • Play with a mix of up to 8 players locally and online

  • 2 game modes across 2 different maps

  • Customise each gamemode with modifiers

  • Find a game online quickly with the game lobby browser

  • Jump between game modes with your friends to keep the fun going

Gamemodes

  • Find your friends: Blend in with AI bots and “find” the other players, be the last player standing.

  • Race: Be the first to the other side of the arena while not revealing yourself to the other players. Try and spot the other players and use your sniper to remove them from the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz (steam deck equivalent)
  • Graphics: 8 RDNA 2 CUs, 1.6GHz (steam deck equivalent)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Graphics: RTX 2060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Master the art of deception to outwit friends & foes in this social deduction party game for 2-8 players that blends stealth, strategy, and deceit. Play online or locally through a variety of mini-games while using cunning and misdirection to locate your friends while staying hidden.
